clips.title: The story
paras: Mull Thunderhorn is a tauren elder residing in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Deeply devoted to the Earth Mother and the balance of the land, he watches over the sacred water wells scattered across the plains. As outside exploiters threaten the region's lifegiving waters, Mull guides young tauren through the rituals required to cleanse the ancestral springs.

Standing watch in Bloodhoof Village, Mull Thunderhorn carries the weight of Mulgore's spiritual well-being. The nomadic tribes have gathered under High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof to establish a permanent home, yet their lands are already under siege by greed and reckless expansion. Mull serves as a spiritual anchor for the young braves stepping out of Camp Narache, calling upon them to safeguard the vital resources of their ancestors.
